_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE TEMPLATE ONLY -- not generated by tools/gen_config.sh, not flashed to any board. For a REAL, generatable AUTO config using the confirmed GPIO profile, copy configs/prototype_sht45.json or configs/prototype_bh1750.json instead -- this file exists purely to show the schema with an unassigned sensor slot (driver_id=0 matches no registered driver on purpose, so module_config_load()/sensor_provider_lookup() both correctly reject it as CONFIG_ERROR rather than silently accepting a fake driver id). Port wiring below IS the real confirmed GPIO profile (see docs/pogo-interface.md) so this file packs successfully; only driver_id/i2c_address/sensor_type_bitmap are placeholders.
_driver_id_comment: 0 matches no registered driver -- CONFIG_ERROR, never a silently-accepted fake. Real values: see components/sensor_provider/include/sensor_provider/sensor_provider.h or write the mnemonic string directly, e.g. "SHT45".
_port_comment: The confirmed, deep-sleep-ready GPIO profile (docs/pogo-interface.md) -- identical on every real board; only the sensor fields above ever differ per board. UPSTREAM DETECT_IN=GPIO12/DETECT_OUT=GPIO2 (swapped from an earlier DETECT_IN=2/DETECT_OUT=12 profile -- GPIO12 is an ESP32-H2 RTC GPIO channel, usable as a future terminal-leaf Deep-sleep wake source).
